intro.text: The capital of Teod, a large seaport surrounded by forest.

description.text: It is best known for its Korathi temple, the largest in Teod.
Its streets are paved with cobblestones, with a main road leading down to the docks, and some of its buildings are made of brick.

items.text: When Sarene was eleven, a troupe of players came through the city, and she announced that she would rather be an actress than a princess.
Dakhor monks led by Dilaf attacked Teoras.
